description: MB_INSTALL v0 failure-mode coverage matrix. All rows must have a non-empty 'mechanism' and 'fixture' field. No PENDING rows remain after Stage 3.

rows.description: Floor write without authorization token — protected_class file written without Robert-auth token
rows.mechanism: check_protected_writes() in tools/metablooms/mb_install_v0.py fails closed when a protected_class file is present and the authorization token is absent or blank

rows.description: Payload and sidecar written non-atomically — sidecar can diverge from payload after partial write
rows.mechanism: restamp_sidecars() writes each sidecar through a same-directory temp file, fsync, and os.replace(); the FM-B fixture simulates replace failure and proves the old sidecar remains intact

rows.description: Governance drop guard — governance contract silently removed during install
rows.mechanism: write_receipt() records governance_contracts from the manifest and validate_receipt() rejects missing governance contracts or non-execution score sources

rows.description: Stage-003B fabrication wound — bundle declares a sha256 that does not match the file's actual bytes
rows.mechanism: verify_bundle() in tools/metablooms/mb_install_v0.py hashes every listed file and rejects hash mismatch, missing payloads, undeclared payloads, duplicate manifest paths, and duplicate zip members
